pilot: D08 Ghi nhận thời lượng xử lý

MOW.step_ids: ordered string keys scoped by MOW Version
Actual C05 and fresh drafts use locally unique step keys; identity = MOW Version UUID + step key. No independent global UUID was observed.
Feedback.id: Existing feedbacks key is integer; native Flow bridge keeps a separate UUID action receipt.
Draft.feedback_id: Native FK now points to the integer feedback key, not its UUID action receipt.
Version.source_revision: MOW publication records originating Draft revision; initial admission or derivation from an immutable Version has no editable source revision. Its source Version/provenance is retained.

count_unit: semantic fact class, not physical columns, implementations, or complete production mappings
production_source_adoption: NOT CLAIMED. Lab generic Definition/Version tables are prototypes, not an order to create parallel production truth. Existing information_unit/unit_version remains a candidate storage backend requiring domain/profile/authority mapping.
new_required_rule: NEW_REQUIRED_LOGICAL_DECLARATION names missing semantic facts/profiles. Per-fact I0–I5 proposal is included. It does not assert a new production table is necessary or approved.
